summary: DIMA AS (org. no. 981 907 337) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2000-05-05. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.110 (Kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom); it has 9 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 3.7 m and net income was -NOK 4.6 m. Board chair: Didrik Johannes Vigsnæs; auditor: CROWE PARTNER REVISJON AS. Also: LEI 254900ZEXDM4FFMZVR73.
